messages:
maya: quick heads-up: q2b-int4 staging shows a small but consistent quality drop on our localization promptset vs qx2b. seems like paraphrase/format drift, not hallucinations. :thinking_face:
santiago: can you paste a failing snippet? locale distribution?
maya: mostly es/fr/ja. example: 
```
prompt: 'Resume esto en 3 puntos'
golden: 'Resumen: 1) ... 2) ... 3) ...'
qx2b: 'Resumen: 1) ... 2) ... 3) ...'
q2b-int4: 'Puntos principales: ...'  <-- drops bullet structure
```
eli: could be dedupe removed anchor paraphrases or tokenizer differences in int4 path. we had seedbank overlap last week.
anya: ran embed-recall diff: slight embedding shift, but structure loss points to tokenization/stripping.
danny: labeling queue shows more "ambiguous" flags; maybe anchors got deduped away.
maya: hypothesis: rolling dedupe pruned longtail anchors. we need a provenance diff between golden for qx2b vs q2b-int4.
santiago: SQL I'll run: SELECT anchor_id, text, hash, model_version FROM golden_anchors WHERE model_version IN ('qx2b-2025','q2b-int4-staging'); I'll diff hashes and counts and upload CSV.
labeling-bot: created review batch rb_20260321_c, size=40, locales=[es,fr,ja], priority=high, queue=multilang-anchors.
anya: propose manual relabel of 30 stratified examples first (locale+length) to confirm delta before changing golden.
eli: can do es/fr tomorrow morning. santi: ja?
santiago: yep. also going to spin a canary with runtime flag off. ops-bot: runtime flag change detected 2026-03-20 02:12 UTC: kernel_path_optimizer=on applied to q2b-int4-staging.
maya: propose A/B: canary pool with kernel_path_optimizer=off routing 10% traffic and metric "anchor_stability" = fraction of prompts with top-1 structure match to golden.
danny: added structure_match (yes/partial/no) to labeling template and backfilled open tasks.
labeling-bot: reviewers assigned: eli (es,fr), santiago (ja). batch rb_20260321_c in progress.
santiago: uploaded /tmp/qbringup-anchor-diff.csv summary: es -12 anchors removed, fr -5, ja 0.
maya: timeline: manual review EOD tomorrow, provenance diff + canary by lunch, then decide rollback flag vs expand anchors. please include a 2-line justification with any golden changes. :memo:
ops-bot: deploy freeze window today 18:00-20:00 UTC.
eli: will update ticket when manual pass done. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
